question: Jallikattu is a _______ held mainly in Tamil Nadu.
solution:
The correct answer is __**bull taming festival.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Jallikattu is a game to control the bull.
 
• It is **bull taming festival.**
 
• It has been played during the Pongal festival in Tamil Nadu.
 
• In Jallikattu, the bull is controlled.
 
• The person controlling it has to remain on his back till a certain distance or three times the bull is jumped.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
